# Test 04: Guarded pattern should not contribute to exhaustiveness
# A guarded type pattern's guard may evaluate to false,
# so it cannot make the switch exhaustive for that type.
# Expected: not exhaustive, Circle missing

TYPES
sealed Shape Circle Square
record Circle double:radius parent:Shape
record Square double:side parent:Shape

SWITCHES
switch s1 Shape
guarded_type Circle
type Square
end
